description: mise resolving tool versions and downloading releases. mise-versions.jdx.dev serves the version manifest; the GitHub hosts serve the release metadata and assets. Read this as what it is: mise may reach all of GitHub. That is inherent to fetching arbitrary tool releases, and the alternative -- a process-wide mise allow -- would be worse. release-assets.githubusercontent.com is pinned exactly rather than reusing the broader [a-z0-9-]+.githubusercontent.com alternation of 062/082, so an asset served from another subdomain raises a prompt instead of passing silently.
name: 084-omarchy-allow-mise-tool-downloads
